team_coverage: All 22 changed files assigned to >=1 agent; utils.js sanitizer double-covered (agents 5,6); all 3 backend controllers + user model covered by focused + cross-cutting agents (1,2,3,12); the 5 new spec files covered by two dedicated ghost-test hunters (14,15).

findings.title: utm_data reaches the jsonb column as two different in-memory types on the two write paths (provably correct at Rails 6.1.7.7; latent-fragility observation)
findings.description: #create path passes a permitted ActionController::Parameters (via expanded_params.merge) so sanitize_for_mass_assignment calls .to_h -> HashWithIndifferentAccess before the jsonb cast; #magic_create builds a plain Ruby Hash so the nested Parameters rides raw into the assignment. Both persist a correct jsonb hash today because actionpack 6.1.7.7 delegates ActionController::Parameters#as_json to @parameters (strong_parameters.rb:246-247). Independently re-verified by agent-12. Correct at this HEAD; noted only so the two-type divergence is on record.
findings.disposition: COLLECT (LOW) — no user-facing defect; does not block convergence.

findings.title: Org 'ignores attribution values sent in the request body' test proves copy-from-user wins, not that strong params rejects the body value
findings.description: The test is falsifiable and not a ghost test (deleting the four copy lines makes the result nil, failing the assertion). It does not independently prove organization_params rejects a body utm_source, but there is no gap because utm_source genuinely is not permitted (organizations_controller.rb:119). Optional strengthening only.
findings.disposition: COLLECT (LOW) — no defect; does not block convergence.

settled_rulings_respected: No agent re-flagged M1/M2/M3/M4 or any of the 9 recorded LOW siblings. Baselines (utils.test.js absent, ~148 pre-existing RSpec failures, pre-existing `ap`/`Devise.mappings[:user]` lines) noted as out-of-scope, not flagged as feature defects.
notable_deep_checks: agents 5 + 6 independently confirmed query-string v6.1.0 parse() alphabetizes keys and the sanitizer correctly derives occurrence order from the raw string (failure-pattern #28 handled); surrogate-safe truncation and rule-13 no-fabrication verified against library source.

agent-7 + agent-13 definitively located the camelCase->snake_case conversion at api.ts:52 (allKeysToSnake), matching sign_up_params snake_case permits; same house convention as pre-existing loginIntent/referral.
agent-12 independently re-proved utm_data jsonb serialization across all four write paths (no fabricated {}, no stringified Parameters, no wrapper).
agent-3 confirmed zero callers remain on the old positional from_omniauth signature.

agents 14 + 15 confirmed all 5 new specs are falsifiable (no ghost tests), carry correct devise.mapping[:api_v1_user] where required, correct :test queue-adapter around blocks (rule 31), and correct stub type-match (rule 7).
